refreshNotes: 2025 expanded trim availability and added the high-performance SS (615 hp Wide Open Watts mode, 0-60 in 3.4s, ~302 mi range). FWD LT added (broadest drivetrain choice in segment - FWD, RWD, AWD all offered across trims). Pricing held roughly flat vs 2024. Software issues from initial launch largely resolved. Sources: [Cars.com 2025](https://www.cars.com/research/chevrolet-blazer-ev-2025/), [Edmunds 2025](https://www.edmunds.com/chevrolet/blazer-ev/2025/).
